### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when scanning legacy protocols that use..."

### Proposed Solution / Capability
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this enhances post-quantum cryptographic posture, formal verification, or CBOM generation.

### Cryptographic Standard & Regulatory Reference
If applicable, reference the relevant standard or guidance:
- [ ] NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM / Kyber)
- [ ] NIST FIPS 204 (ML-DSA / Dilithium)

- [ ] White House OMB M-23-02 / Executive Order 14028
- [ ] CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM Cryptography Extension

- [ ] Other: (specify RFC, ITU-T, or academic paper)

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, code examples, SMT constraints, or diagrams here.
